tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Filled buttons, active navigation, links, selected seats and progress. Text in primary reads on surface, surface-dim and surface-container-low (6.1:1 or more in light, 10.9:1 in dark).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary fills.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Tonal buttons, active nav pill, success chips and confirmed states.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-container (10.3:1 light, 7.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Wheat accent for secondary emphasis: pending states, fares, loyalty. Text in secondary reads on surface (6.4:1).

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary fills.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Warning and pending chips, wheat buttons, fare highlights.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-container and secondary-soft.

tokens.name: secondary-soft
tokens.usage: Warning banner ground and the warm end of hero washes.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Information accent: informational banners, in-progress trip states, tracking.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tertiary fills.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Info chips and in-progress badges.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tertiary-container and tertiary-soft.

tokens.name: tertiary-soft
tokens.usage: Information banner ground.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text, destructive actions and invalid field outlines. Reads on surface (6.5:1 light, 9.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text on error fills.

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Error banners, cancelled and rejected chips.

tokens.name: on-error-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on error-container (7.2:1 both themes).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs, app bars and table bodies.

tokens.name: surface-dim
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards on web and app screens.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Quiet tinted panels: table headers, hover rows, info cards.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Filled text fields, bottom navigation bar, hover fills.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Progress tracks, taken seats, pressed states.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Skeleton loaders and the deepest nested container.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface token (16:1 light, 14.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, inactive icons on every surface token (8.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Text-field and outlined-button borders, and other control edges that must reach 3:1 (4.5:1 on surface).

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Decorative borders only: card outlines, chip outlines, seat outlines next to a label. Never the only edge of an input.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows, table rows and sections.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbars and tooltips.

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-surface (11.6:1).

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Action text inside a snackbar.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal dialogs and drawers, at 32 percent opacity.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: Identity green, taken from the Syrian flag. Logos, app icon backgrounds, cover blocks and marketing only; UI uses primary.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Identity gold, inspired by the golden eagle of the national emblem. Decorative fills, logo route line, illustrations; never text on white (2.3:1).

tokens.name: brand-gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold when it must be read as text or a meaningful icon: loyalty tier labels, premium fare brand names (6.4:1 light, 9.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Identity near-black for print, signage and the dark ticket band.

tokens.name: brand-sand
tokens.usage: Identity sand for print, station signage and marketing grounds.
